errata.title: DMA maximum-burst discovery truncation
errata.applies_to: Tiny v0.2 / reviewed dev / 8-channel central DMA
errata.trigger: Reading the four-bit maximum-burst discovery field with a configured engine maximum of 16 beats.
errata.impact: The field reads zero; interpreting it as no supported burst loses the actual 16-beat engine limit.
errata.workaround: Preserve raw readback and the source-bound integration limit separately; use capability-aware, product-specific initialization.
errata.evidence: Current RTL/source review. No RTL repair or new silicon result is part of this publication.

errata.title: SPI DMA capability-bit discrepancy
errata.applies_to: Tiny V2.2 SPI0 path in the reviewed v0.2 source
errata.trigger: Relying only on CAPABILITY bit 7 to discover Tiny SPI DMA.
errata.impact: The bit reads zero although Tiny connects the DMA admission/readiness path.
errata.workaround: Use the reviewed Tiny integration contract and retain version/configuration checks; request a separate RTL/SDK compatibility decision before changing discovery.
errata.evidence: Current instance and register source review; historical SPI acceptance retains its original revision/profile.

errata.title: Functional PLL profiles are not a physical operating qualification
errata.applies_to: Tiny ICS55 main reference; R2-P7 policy
errata.trigger: Treating a functional R2-P7 PLL192/PLL240 selection or a calculated curve as a timing-qualified SYS operating point.
errata.impact: The RTL supports conditional drain/park/qualify/commit transitions; this does not establish final timing closure, board margin, analog lock or measured power.
errata.workaround: Boot in SAFE24 with the PLL off. Use R2-P7 capability, lock, drain and recovery checks for a requested transition; require matching timing/physical evidence before publishing an operating rating.
errata.evidence: Historical negative IHP130 STA and later phase decisions remain in docs/ip/tiny-soc-verification.md with their original identities; current publication adds no matching hardware report.
